paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 55b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.55b.20): “It was taught: Eliezer of Biriya says.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked baraita names Eliezer of Biriya without a title. Hyman quotes only its introduction.
